children.name: A selection control for binary choices. 48 option variants (3 Checked states × 2 Sizes × 4 Validations × States) + a wrapper with label and helper text.
Inner component with 48 variants: 3 Checked (Checked, Intermediate, Unchecked) × 2 Sizes (S, M) × 4 Validations (Default, Error, Warning, Success) × States (Default, Hover, Pressed) + Disabled.
Internal component — use the Checkbox wrapper in layouts.
Wrapper that adds label text, helper text, and focus ring on top of .Checkbox-options. Properties: Main text, Helper text, Show Label, Show Helper, Focused.
This is the component to use in layouts.
A selection control for mutually exclusive choices. 32 option variants (2 Checked × 2 Sizes × 4 Validations × States) + a wrapper with label and helper text.
Inner component with 32 variants: 2 Checked (On, Off) × 2 Sizes (S, M) × 4 Validations (Default, Danger, Success, Warning) × States (Default/Checked, Hover, Pressed).
Internal component — use the Radio Button wrapper in layouts.
Wrapper that adds label text, helper text, and focus ring. Properties: Main text, Helper text, Show Label, Show helper, Focused.
This is the component to use in layouts.
A toggle control for instant on/off actions. 32 option variants (2 Checked × 2 Sizes × 4 Validations × States) + a wrapper with label, helper text, and focus ring.

Inner component with 32 variants: 2 Checked (On, Off) × 2 Sizes (S, M) × 4 Validations (Default, Danger, Success, Warning) × States (Default, Hover, Pressed, Checked). 7 tokens: Radius (full), Width S (32px), Width M (40px), Border Width (thin), Knob Padding (2px), Switch Gap (8px), Text Gap (6px).
Internal component — use the Switch wrapper in layouts.
Wrapper that adds label text, helper text, and focus ring. Properties: Label text, Helper Text, Show Label, Show helper, Focused.
